shots.shot_type_other: one continuous shot that chains kinetic-type headlines, a recreated Notion UI demo (Projects board pushed into the Notion AI chat panel) and a logo lockup
shots.focal_element: Centered black headlines, then the Notion AI chat panel with a typed question and a sourced answer, ending on the Notion logo lockup
on_screen_text: Optimize internal systems for better tracking & reporting
What is the mobile team working on this week?
They’re working on updating assets on app stores.
They also recently dealt with an outage
shots.typography: Same bold/semibold neo-grotesque sans as earlier shots (Inter or Notion's own sans, low confidence), sentence case, slightly tight tracking, centered two-line and one-line headlines; each word fades in from light grey to near-black in sequence. UI uses small regular-weight sans; the user question sits in a grey pill bubble, the answer in regular weight with a small blue citation badge. Final lockup is the Notion wordmark in bold sans beside the cube logo.
shots.what_happens: "Access all your company’s knowledge" finishes building word by word and holds; it clears and "without leaving Notion" builds the same way. At ~22s a full Notion Projects kanban board appears as a shadowed window, then the camera pushes in fast with motion blur onto the board's right side; the cursor moves to the bottom-right AI button and the Notion AI chat panel opens over the board. The question "What is the mobile team working on this week?" types into the input, is sent and rises into a grey bubble; an answer appears below with a citation badge, "1 source found", a page and a Slack thread source; the cursor hovers the citation badge. The frame clears to blank, "Try it now" builds word by word, then the Notion cube logo appears alone and the "Notion" wordmark slides in beside it. Board card details and the badge number are too small to read reliably.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the per-word opacity headline component for two headlines, then show a shadowed kanban window, scale it ~2.5x toward its bottom-right with a short motion blur, open a chat panel, type the question character by character (~25 chars/s), move it into a right-aligned bubble and fade in a two-line answer plus a source list, then clear to a 'Try it now' headline and a logo-then-wordmark lockup.

hook.text: Can’t find what you’re looking for?

summary.tone: Calm, minimal and confident: off-white canvas, black kinetic type, real-looking product UI, light music bed with no voice-over.

signature_moments.description: Six integration icons fly in with motion blur and a grey highlight scans across them on the beat, cut into tight crops that keep the scan rhythm.
signature_moments.why_premium: Shows the whole integration story in seconds without words, and the beat-locked scan plus hard crops give energy from very few elements.

signature_moments.description: The icon row collapses into a single Notion logo, then the 'Introducing Notion AI connectors' headline slides left as the Slack connect modal slides in and a cursor ticks channels.
signature_moments.why_premium: One continuous re-layout carries the viewer from idea to product with no cut, so the headline and the UI read as one argument.

signature_moments.description: A fast blurred push from the Projects board into the AI panel, where a typed question returns a cited answer drawing on a Slack thread.
signature_moments.why_premium: The payoff is shown, not told: the cited Slack source proves the connector claim inside a believable product moment.

hook.evidence: Recognisable app icons in motion grab attention instantly and lead into a relatable question headline; it takes ~7s before any text appears, which is slow for a 32s piece.

clarity.evidence: One idea per beat: problem question, product name, connect step, benefit line, demo answer with sources, CTA. Short headlines and real UI make the value obvious.

ui_showcase.evidence: Two crisp product moments (Slack channel connect modal, AI chat with cited answer) with a scripted cursor; small UI text and the brief board view are hard to read at 2 fps scale.

motion_polish.evidence: Consistent per-word fade reveals, a motion-blurred icon entrance, icon-to-logo merge, headline/modal re-layout and a blurred camera push; motion is clean but conservative and reuses one text effect throughout.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors only: a ~97.5 BPM music bed at -23.5 LUFS integrated, and just three detected events, all in s005 (swoosh_reverse at 24.8s near the typing/panel open, a music event at 28.1s, swoosh_reverse at 29.8s before the logo). The icon scan visually follows the beat grid. Competent and quiet, not distinctive.

vo_script_quality.evidence: No voice-over: the anchors transcript has no words; the script is carried entirely by on-screen text.

brand_consistency.evidence: Notion's off-white canvas, black sans headlines, genuine Notion UI and a closing cube-logo lockup stay consistent from first to last frame.

works_muted.evidence: No voice-over; every message is on-screen text or visible UI, so the video reads fully with sound off.

overall.evidence: A tight, on-brand 32s launch teaser with a clear problem-product-proof-CTA arc and polished but restrained motion; audio and the slow opening keep it short of best-in-class.

localization_friendliness.notes: No voice-over, so no dubbing is needed, but all headlines are animated per word and the UI (channel names, typed question, AI answer, board cards) is baked in English; localising means re-rendering the headline animations and re-capturing or rebuilding the UI.
